note: What a server sends to show a ping on the map to everyone meant to see it.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the ping sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit pinged, or zero where a place was pinged instead.

bits.name: playSound
bits.note: Set where the client plays a sound for it. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: showInChat
bits.note: Set where the client writes a line about it. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: wasThrottled
bits.note: Set where the sender was pinging faster than allowed. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set where the unit says something about it. Set in everything observed.
